title: Cascading menu to trigger creation of new orders

comments_data.body:
Hi @IanMayo, I think I have integrated the select control successfully, since we don't have any wrapper I import the js and css files in index.html, I also add a type for the Select control but the problem I have must be the control position. As you can see, the library only supports displaying the menu from left to right, not vice versa. So if you put the button on the right side, the menu will be cut off.

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26705621/195992896-335db209-fec1-4a01-ae28-63302a05c28a.mov

> Hi @IanMayo, I think I have integrated the select control successfully, since we don't have any wrapper I import the js and css files in index.html, I also add a type for the Select control but the problem I have must be the control position. As you can see, the library only supports displaying the menu from left to right, not vice versa. So if you put the button on the right side, the menu will be cut off.

Ok, I can live with it being on the left-hand side.  Just one change: we don't need checkboxes for the menu items - clicking a menu item will trigger an event.  So, when a "branch" is clicked it will expand, and when a "leaf" is clicked the event fires and the menu collapses.
Aah, DeepScan is failing because of errors in `Leaflet.control.select`.  I don't want us to fix third party code.  So, I'd like you to configure the build to exclude these files from testing, please.
sure @IanMayo
https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26705621/196020969-0c70c1ca-fbb6-4666-87be-bacdf776c054.mov

Nice work.
Two things:
1. there is another tier/level above the one in your demo: the Land, Maritime, Air one.
2. We don't show the bottom tier/level (route-in, search, route-out). So, stop at the level of `precision strike`.

issues.title: Bug in storing planned route
issues.body:
**Describe the bug**
A player can plan a turn using a number of discrete steps.  But, when we store that route, we're just storing the direct route from the start cell to the end cell.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Enter game as Player, instruct mobile platform to travel at more than 10 kts (maybe need to be Blue Frigate to do that)

**Expected behavior**
The route should he represented as the series of discrete steps

**Screenshots**
![Animation of selecting route](https://i.gyazo.com/a63ca8e684836d226418b83d44ee252a.gif)
